title: Djokovic hopeful of 'fresh start' for Serbia after students win election

blocks.text: PARIS — Tennis star Novak Djokovic said on Monday he hoped Serbia’s student movement would mark a “fresh start for the country” after its election victory over longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic. On October 25, after nearly two years of anti-government protests, the student-backed list achieved a historic victory in snap elections called by Vucic. The poll results ended 14 years in power for Vucic’s right-wing populist party. The win for the student-led movement was the culmination of long-running protests sparked by the 2024 collapse of a railway station canopy in the city of Novi Sad that killed 16 people.
